text:
Laura: Heads-up — I'm adding sable-3b v2 to the model registry. Planning a canary tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need smoke owners + rollback plan.
Jyoti: I can own smoke checks. What are perf expectations?
Matt: Perf target: within 5% latency p95 of v1 and no drop in eval pass-rate. I'll open the PR for the registry pin.
Laura: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/srv/pull/4321 — contains model pin + traffic config. @Ezra can you review before the canary?
Ezra: On it. Quick notes: change default batch_size to 8 for 3b, add a warmup job to prevent cold-kv spikes.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Laura for 1849996600 (tomorrow 09:30 PT).
Jyoti: Smoke plan (short):
  1) run 10k eval prompts from the nightly suite
  2) compare p50/p95 histograms to baseline
  3) run the safety/regressions quickchecks
  4) sanity-check token cost delta
I'll post results here.
Matt: Rollback plan (manual quick command):
```
redwoodctl rollout --model sable-3b --version v1-20240115 --force
redwoodctl set-config --model sable-3b --autoscaler.max_pods 2
```
Laura: Canary policy: 5% for first 30m, if stable -> 25% for 1h, then 100%. Immediate rollback triggers: error rate > baseline * 2, p95 > baseline * 1.5, or eval regressions flagged.
Ezra: Pushed a tiny patch to the PR to add the warmup job and extra smoke metrics (trace ids + token hist). LGTM after CI passes.
Jyoti: I'll run the smoke at 09:35 PT and paste outputs.
Laura: Please be on standby 09:20-10:30 PT. Ping here if you need help: @Matt @Ezra @Jyoti
Matt: :thumbsup: I'll be around.
deploy-bot: Canary started 1849996600.020000 — 5% traffic -> sable-3b@v2
Jyoti: Smoke finished 1849996660: eval pass 98.6% (baseline 98.9), p95 142ms (baseline 135ms). Small latency bump but within the 5% threshold. Logs: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-smoke/sable-v2/1849996660.log
Laura: Thanks — we'll monitor the 30m window and promote to 25% if no regressions. If anyone sees anything odd, call rollback and paste the rollback command above.
